summary: Operator-approved PostgreSQL tables read as they are, with the person's declarations; any table, not only wells.

routes.data: Any table, as its columns and rows
losses: Columns of types outside the eight logical types are listed as not read; their values are not delivered and not in the revision
Declared units, descriptions, missing-value markers and coordinates are annotations; no value is converted
A table is read once inside one read-only snapshot, up to 100,000 rows, 64 MiB and 128 columns
unsupported: schema changes without a new reviewed declaration

redistribution: Ophiolite source; the PostgreSQL server is customer-operated.
